001-empty-days.json.note: No day has been counted yet, so days is an empty object and hooks are not connected.

002-one-claude-day.json.note: One live day with one tool and the hooks connected a day after the founding crate.

003-hooks-not-yet-connected.json.note: hooks_first_connected_day is null, so the bell post has not arrived yet.

004-hooks-on-founding-day.json.note: The hooks connected on the same local day the founding crate arrived.

005-tool-claude.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the claude tool.

006-tool-codex.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the codex tool.

007-tool-opencode.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the opencode tool.

008-tool-antigravity.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the antigravity tool.

009-tool-gemini.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the gemini tool.

010-tool-cursor.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the cursor tool.

011-tool-aider.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the aider tool.

012-tool-other.json.note: A single live day with counts recorded for the other tool.

013-all-tools-one-day.json.note: All eight tool keys present on one day.

014-two-tools-same-day.json.note: Two tools counted on the same day.

015-zero-counters.json.note: Every counter at zero on a day that still exists.

016-counters-at-max.json.note: Every counter at its 1000000 maximum, and working_seconds at its 90000 cap.

017-working-seconds-max.json.note: working_seconds at exactly 90000, the wall-clock cap that allows a 25-hour daylight-saving day.

018-working-seconds-one-day.json.note: working_seconds at 86400, one full 24-hour day of wall-clock time.

019-working-seconds-zero.json.note: working_seconds at zero with no sessions or turns started.

020-error-counters-nonzero.json.note: Error, recovery and limit counters all non-zero on one day.

021-mixed-tools-many-days.json.note: Several days with different tool sets, including a day with only zero-valued counts for gemini.

022-many-days.json.note: Thirty consecutive live days of Claude activity.

023-month-boundary-days.json.note: Days on either side of the month boundary, 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01.

024-leap-day-key.json.note: A day key on 2028-02-29, which the day pattern accepts.

029-backfill-one-day.json.note: A backfill holding a single imported day.

030-backfill-31-days.json.note: A backfill with exactly 31 days, the maximum.

031-backfill-empty-days.json.note: A backfill that was imported but holds no days.

032-backfill-imported-at-min.json.note: imported_at at the legal minimum, 2000-01-01 UTC.

033-backfill-imported-at-max.json.note: imported_at at the legal maximum, 2100-01-01 UTC.

034-backfill-and-live-days.json.note: A backfill alongside two live days on different tools.

035-subagent-turns-only.json.note: A day whose only activity is subagent turns with no main-session turns.

036-interrupted-turns-at-max.json.note: interrupted_turns at its 1000000 maximum with everything else ordinary.

037-backfill-imported-at-mid-range.json.note: A backfill imported at an ordinary mid-range timestamp, 400 days before the reference day.

038-day-totals-union.json.note: Optional day_totals holds the wall-clock union across tools for a day, which can be less than the per-tool sum.

039-day-totals-max.json.note: day_totals working_seconds may be 90000 (a 25-hour daylight-saving day).

041-day-totals-empty.json.note: day_totals may be an empty object.

042-day-totals-extra-day.json.note: day_totals is independent of days: it may list a day that has no per-tool counts (no cross-field rule).

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-root-string.json.note: The root must be an object, not a string.

008-missing-hooks-first-connected-day.js.note: hooks_first_connected_day is required even though it may be null.

009-missing-days.json.note: days is required, even when empty.

010-missing-backfill.json.note: backfill is required even though it may be null.

015-privacy-extra-field.json.note: privacy is closed, so a project field is rejected.

016-seed-negative.json.note: seed is an unsigned integer, so a negative value is rejected.

018-seed-string.json.note: seed must be a JSON integer, not a string.

019-founded-day-month-13.json.note: founded_day must be a valid YYYY-MM-DD day.

020-hooks-day-today.json.note: hooks_first_connected_day must be a day or null, not a relative word.

021-days-key-month-13.json.note: A day key with month 13 breaks the day pattern.

022-days-key-unpadded.json.note: A day key with an unpadded month and day breaks the day pattern.

023-days-key-today.json.note: The word today is not a day key.

024-day-with-no-tools.json.note: A listed day needs at least one tool.

025-unknown-tool-key.json.note: Tool keys come from the closed list of eight tools.

027-counter-negative.json.note: A counter may not be negative.

028-counter-fractional.json.note: A counter is a whole number, so 1.5 is rejected.

029-counter-string.json.note: A counter is a JSON number, not a string.

031-working-seconds-over-max.json.note: working_seconds may not exceed 90000, so 90001 is rejected.

032-working-seconds-old-max.json.note: working_seconds at the pre-r1 value 5529600 is now above the 90000 maximum.

033-counts-quick-answers-present.json.note: quick_answers was removed by SPEC Revision 1, so the closed counts object rejects it as an unknown property.

035-counts-missing-field.json.note: Every counter is required, and errors is missing here.

036-counts-extra-field.json.note: The counts object is closed, so a project field is rejected.

037-counts-not-object.json.note: A tool's counts must be an object.

038-day-value-not-object.json.note: A day's value must be an object keyed by tool.

039-days-is-array.json.note: days must be an object keyed by day, not an array.

040-backfill-32-days.json.note: A backfill may hold at most 31 days.

042-backfill-missing-days.json.note: A backfill needs its days object.

043-backfill-imported-at-seconds.json.note: imported_at in seconds is below the millisecond range.

044-backfill-imported-at-fractional.json.note: imported_at must be a whole number of milliseconds.

046-backfill-extra-field.json.note: The backfill object is closed, so a source field is rejected.

047-backfill-bad-day-key.json.note: Backfill day keys follow the same day pattern as live days.

048-backfill-counter-over-max.json.note: Backfill counters obey the same 1000000 maximum.

049-backfill-not-object.json.note: backfill is an object or null, not a string.

050-day-totals-over-max.json.note: day_totals working_seconds may not exceed 90000, so 90001 is rejected.

051-day-totals-key-month-13.json.note: A day_totals key with month 13 breaks the day pattern.

052-day-totals-extra-property.json.note: The day_totals value is closed: only working_seconds is allowed.

053-day-totals-negative.json.note: day_totals working_seconds may not be negative.

054-day-totals-fractional.json.note: day_totals working_seconds is a whole number, so 1.5 is rejected.

056-day-totals-value-not-object.json.note: A day_totals value must be an object, not a number.

057-day-totals-is-array.json.note: day_totals must be an object keyed by day, not an array.

058-day-totals-null.json.note: day_totals is optional but never null: leave it out instead.

059-day-totals-string-seconds.json.note: day_totals working_seconds is a number, not a string.
